_comment: Characterisation of the campaign's unenumerated PC. Regenerate: tools/phase4_e16_speculative_read_probe.py
actual_access_instruction: 0x80010BF4  lhu $t9,0($t9)  (accessLog reports the PC after the access)

why_static_work_missed_it.scope: 0x80010BF4 is in no function in analysis/functions_resident.txt; the emitter entry at 0x80010000 is 724 bytes and ends at 0x800102D4, which is the loop head 0x80010C88 jumps back to.
why_static_work_missed_it.form: the base register $s1 is not a lui constant, so the access is not region-formed and the affine census is structurally blind to it -- fixing the function list alone would NOT have surfaced it.

verdict: READS INSIDE THE WINDOW -- 8 distinct in-window addresses, read only (no writes). Consistent with the load being hoisted past its own bounds check at 0x80010BF8 and the value discarded, but that makes it a real reader of these bytes for enumeration purposes: add it to the enumerated set with this characterisation.
